entries.mechanism: EUROMOD returned 0 because this comparison coded the German-speaking Community households as region 4 (drgn1=4), a value EUROMOD's data codebook never assigns for Belgium and that BE_2025's family-benefit policies bch_be and bchba_be never test. The J2.0 codebook derives drgn1 from the SILC NUTS-1 code db040 (BE1 to 1, BE2 to 2, BE3 to 3), BE_2025's own conditions name 1 Brussels, 2 Flanders and 3 Wallonia, and its child-benefit conditions test only those three values, so a household coded 4 meets none of them. BE_2025 holds no child-benefit rules of the Community's own. EUROMOD's Belgian parameter file gives the Walloon arrondissements codes in the 300 series and codes the German-speaking part of the Verviers arrondissement 335, though no BE_2025 policy uses these codes. Axiom pays the Community decree amounts: the Article 8 base of 157 EUR a month plus the Article 117 paragraph 4 annual supplement of 62.55 EUR for 2025. The Brussels, Flanders and Wallonia cases in the same suite match within the comparison's tolerance (1 EUR or 0.1 percent, whichever is larger). From BE_2025's conditions we infer that a household coded drgn1=3 would get EUROMOD's Walloon amounts, so the comparison would set Axiom's Community rule against them; this comparison has not run those cases.
